_readme: What the engine searches for. Filled in from your resume the first time; change it any time in Search preferences.

ats_companies._readme: Company career boards checked directly (no key). Slugs that do not exist are skipped automatically and remembered in data/ats_cache.json. Add any company: the slug is the name in its careers URL, e.g. jobs.lever.co/<slug>, boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>.

workday_sites._readme: Optional. Paste Workday career URLs like https://<tenant>.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>. Each is searched with every query.
